description: A corner en-suite in pale veined marble, warm underfoot. The shower is a seam in the floor behind one pane of glass, its back wall black marble. A walnut vanity floats under a mirror lit from behind, and nothing in here has a handle you have to find.

window.description: A high slot of frosted glass under the ceiling. It lets the day in and nobody look back.
window.name: the frosted slot

name: Residence 5-B en-suite
